arguments.help: Attach a local file (CSV/TSV/XLSX/PDF/image) to this chat; repeat for up to 8 files. An export from an exchange with no dedicated importer can be analyzed and imported. A provider with full agent access sees the CSV's cell values, the images, and the PDFs' text (or page images of a scan); a restricted provider sees the CSV's headers and row counts and none of the images or PDFs.

arguments.name: file_context
arguments.help: Tell the assistant what an attached file is, e.g. "2024 export from exchange XYZ, custodial account"; the nth --file-context describes the nth --file. Context for the assistant, not a claim Kassiber books: values still come from the file.

arguments.help: Maximum seconds to wait for daemon startup or provider stream activity. This is local transport control and is not sent in the prompt.

arguments.help: Ask for the model's fast serving mode (Codex Fast service tier, Claude Opus fast mode). Billed at a higher rate; ignored by models and providers without one.

arguments.name: tool_profile
arguments.help: Tool schema to expose to the model: full (default) offers the complete catalog; scoped offers the tools behind the current question and lets the model load more; core keeps a small common set for small local models.

arguments.name: permission_mode
arguments.help: Who approves the assistant's changes: approval (default) asks before each one; auto approves changes another tool can undo and that stay on this machine, and asks for the rest; full_access approves everything, network actions such as syncs included.

arguments.help: Non-interactively allow mutating AI tools, except ui.review.apply (fresh review required).

arguments.help: Non-interactively allow only this mutating tool name; repeat or pass comma-separated names. Other mutating tools still prompt on a TTY or deny without one. ui.review.apply always requires fresh interactive review.

arguments.name: stream_json
arguments.help: One-shot scripting mode: emit the raw daemon stream records (ai.chat.status/delta/tool_call/tool_result and the terminal ai.chat) as NDJSON instead of rendered text.

arguments.name: transcript
arguments.help: Append every daemon request and stream record for this chat session to PATH as NDJSON. The file is plaintext and includes prompts and redacted tool results.

arguments.name: plain
arguments.help: Disable terminal markdown rendering and deterministic tool-result tables; print the raw model output.

arguments.name: incognito
arguments.help: Do not persist this chat to the database, regardless of the history setting.

arguments.help: Continue the most recently updated persisted chat session.

arguments.help: Continue a specific persisted chat session (see `kassiber chats list`).
